source.name: visualization_-_aerial.dwg
source.rawFrames: Both type-42 dictionaries have a 12-byte body, the handle stream at bit 60, 36 declared handle bits, zero entries, cloning 1 and hard-owner flag 0. Parent and reactor each use absolute soft pointer code 4 length 1 and resolve C.

exactTailProof.frames: At logical object-section offsets 1093 (19) and 21685 (73), both owners occupy [60,76) and both reactors occupy [76,92). The exact source bits at [92,96) are 1111 in both frames.
exactTailProof.peer: LibreDWG 0.14 on the pinned source independently reports the handle/body boundaries, four residual bits, matching CRCs 8FEB and FCAB, and following indexed records 1A and 86. The actual residual bit values are observed from the captured source bytes.
exactTailProof.controls: The standalone exact-frame cursor and generated adapter-wire vector each reject all 96 single-bit changes per record and accept the original body again. The selected source guard checks the terminal nibble explicitly through the reusable LayerStates observer.

stagedOutput.projection: Admit five selected source roots for the scratch output and preserve their order. Retain GROUP, the ordered plot-style pair and all 32 scales from the previous projection. Bind ACAD_COLOR and ACAD_PLOTSETTINGS to unique staged dictionaries A073 and A019, with empty bodies, owner C and reactor C.
stagedOutput.faultControls: Both encodings pass 20 injected refusals, seeded destination retention and corrected same-codec retries. The new controls include the wrong color owner/cloning, wrong plot-settings reactor or nonempty body, and a corrupted original color source frame.
stagedOutput.peerControls: ezdxf 1.4.5 reads the same ordering, selected root roles, and child and graph roles from the produced ASCII and Binary outputs and the prior official Linux ODA 27.10.0.0 output.

productionIntegration.scope: Retain the imported NOD and immutable baseline. When the observed AC1024 pair is selected, require both root keys, the same adapter's retained import-session proof, original membership and compatible frame publications, and the exact two physical child bodies. The generic object proof and identity ledger must contain both dictionary records with NOD owner C before publication.
productionIntegration.transaction: A test-only output selection sends both roots plus GROUP and PLOTSTYLENAME through the production generated-root inspector and source-object finalizers with the original importer and data. Both encodings reject a changed source tail, a foreign import session, missing root, missing root baseline, wrong staged child body and a late tail mutation. All six failures preserve the original destination and accept a corrected retry on the same codec.
productionIntegration.independentReadback: ezdxf 1.4.5 independently checks both corrected encodings against the selected ODA tags. The four root keys retain their source order. COLOR and PLOTSETTINGS have group-350 links to A073 and A019, with empty bodies, cloning 1, owner C and reactor C.
productionIntegration.regressions: Four focused CTests and the existing manual SCALELIST writer and whole-source fallback controls pass.

remaining: The new guard closes the proofs for the two empty children when selected. The five-edge scratch output and four-edge production-inspector harness each omit other original edges. The complete source still requires closure of the remaining NOD relationships, the whole-file SUN or SORTENTSTABLE ownership conflict, and native acceptance.
